channel.title: The Grant Desk - Media Arts, Film & Sound, Africa, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Media Arts, Film & Sound, Africa, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily.

item.title: 1 new Media Arts, Film & Sound grant - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Connect and Create: Circulation of Performing Arts and Music (Africa-Europe) - 2nd Call
    https://ifprog.emundus.fr/en/campagne-info?view=programme&cid=353
    Goethe-Institut and Expertise France, in collaboration with Institut francais (Africa-Europe Partnerships for Culture consortium) · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · EUR 15,000 to EUR 39,500 per project, covering travel, visas, insurance, accommodation, per diems, local transport and shipping of scenographic and technical elements. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 3 new Media Arts, Film & Sound grants - week of 03 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Marrakech IFF: Atlas Station 2026 (Producers Track)
    https://atlasateliers.marrakech-festival.com/en/call-for-applications
    Festival International du Film de Marrakech (Atlas Workshops) · deadline Closed 31 Aug 2026 · No application fee. Participation in the online and onsite professional programme is covered.
  • Marrakech IFF: Atlas Station 2026 (Short Film Track)
    https://atlasateliers.marrakech-festival.com/en/call-for-applications
    Festival International du Film de Marrakech (Atlas Workshops) · deadline 14 Sep 2026 · No application fee. Participation in the online and onsite professional programme is covered.
  • Gallery 1957: Yaa Asantewaa Art Prize 2026
    https://www.gallery1957.com/the-yaa-asantewaa-art-prize/
    Gallery 1957 · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · USD 5,000 cash per winner, two winners (one Ghanaian, one Senegalese), plus a fully covered three-month residency exchange: flights, transportation of artworks, accommodation and materials. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).
